EA_FLOW_COMPLETE_ENGLAND_NETWORK
The dataset describes a complete overland-flow-pathway network for England.
EA_FLOW_HYDRO_ENFORCED_DTM
It is derived from a hydro-enforced one-metre bare-earth DTM based on the 2022 LIDAR Composite.
EA_FLOW_LIMITATION
The model uses theoretical one-hectare flow accumulation and does not model infiltration differences between surfaces and soils.
EA_DSM1_COVERAGE
The one-metre DSM covers approximately 99 percent of England.
EA_DSM1_SURFACE_OBJECTS
It includes terrain plus surface objects such as vehicles, buildings and vegetation.
EA_DSM1_2022_COMPOSITE
The 2022 composite combines time-stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys, preferring newer best-resolution coverage.
EA_FZDSM1_COVERAGE
The first-return DSM covers approximately 99 percent of England at one-metre resolution.
EA_FZDSM1_FIRST_RETURN
It uses the first or only laser return and can include objects as well as terrain.
EA_FZDSM1_NATIONAL_PROGRAMME
It is derived from National LIDAR Programme surveys captured from November 2016 to May 2022.
OS_PORTFOLIO_PURPOSE
The portfolio supports ground-surface description, land-use classification, elevation and slope modelling.
OS_PORTFOLIO_TERRAIN5
OS Terrain 5 is described as a detailed DTM supplied as heighted points or contours at five-metre intervals.
OS_PORTFOLIO_TERRAIN50
OS Terrain 50 is described as an open height dataset with contours, spot heights, breaklines and other terrain features.
OS_T5_NO_LIVE_ISSUES
The current known-data-issues page reports no live OS Terrain 5 issues.
OS_T5_RESOLVED_RETENTION
Resolved issue details remain listed until the next product release.
OS_T5_REPORTING_ROUTE
The page directs users to the OS contact route for issues not already listed.
